# Python environment for bin/scratch_scoda.py (compositional differential
# abundance). Only needed when TME runs with `run_scoda: true`; the notebook
# degrades with a visible warning if this environment is absent.
#
#   python3 -m venv scoda_env && ./scoda_env/bin/pip install -r scoda-requirements.txt
#
# Point the notebook at it with `-P scoda_python:/path/to/scoda_env/bin/python`
# or `export SCRATCH_SCODA_PYTHON=/path/to/scoda_env/bin/python`.
#
# The two pins below are NOT cosmetic -- a bare `pip install sccoda` produces an
# environment that imports and then fails:
#
#   scipy<1.13   scCODA 0.1.9 pulls arviz 0.17, which imports
#                `scipy.signal.gaussian`. That alias was removed in scipy 1.13
#                (it moved to scipy.signal.windows), so the import dies.
#   tf-keras     tensorflow-probability 0.25 needs Keras 2. TF 2.16+ ships
#                Keras 3, and TFP does not install the compatibility shim
#                itself, so `import sccoda` fails on a clean install.
#
# Verified working combination (macOS arm64, 2026-08-01): scCODA 0.1.9,
# tensorflow 2.20.0, tensorflow-probability 0.25.0, arviz 0.17.1, numpy 1.26.4,
# scipy 1.12.0, pandas 2.3.3, Python 3.9.

sccoda==0.1.9
scipy<1.13
tf-keras
